name: SMILEY

script.text: @HINTS-INTRODUCTION#END:TOUCHHi, I am your friendly on line hints.If you are stumped, I am around to keep  you going.Touching me will give you specific cluesabout the room or screen you are playing.      (Arrow down for more info)Pressing the H key is different.  It willgive you general information about howto play the game.I may give you brief information at thetop of the message.  If you want moreyou can move to another note.  Use thearrow keys to move the text until themarked text aligns with the sideindicators.  Press enter.!TRY;Press enter at this line.Or, go to the line below this one.!GO;What to do next.  Press enter here.Enter (or escape) on another line exits hints.#END:TRYMore clues will be here.  You can choosenot to look at them if you want to havethe fun of discovering the world foryourself.!TOUCH;Enter here to return to hints   Or, go to the line below this one.!GO;What to do next.  Press enter here. #END:GOPress enter (or escape) and head Northto Bog Woods.!TOUCH;Enter here to return to hints    #END
@SWAMPFLY:MOVE?W?E?SEEK#IF CONTACT THEN TOUCH#SEND MOVE#END:TOUCH"Eech!  Swamp flies."#TAKE HEALTH 7 TOOWEAK#DIE#END:SHOT#DIE:TOOWEAK#ENDGAME
It's a note.  It says:"Smiley, come quick.  I need your help.                   Your friend,                   Bog"

@HUNTER#END:DO#CHAR 02#RESTART:TOUCHA hunter walks out of the woods.  He says,"Keep looking for Bog.  I hear the woodshave hidden gems which can be used inDr. Z's lab."#ZAP TOUCH#END:TOUCHA hunter walks out of the woods.  He says,"Have a nice day."#END:SHOT"No violence, please."#END

@WOODSMAN#END:DO#CHAR 02#RESTART:TOUCHA woodsman appears.  He says,"Get the torches.  They light up dark rooms." #ZAP TOUCH#END:TOUCHA woodsman appears.  He says,"Have a nice day."#END:SHOT"No violence, please."#END

@HIKER#END:DO#CHAR 02#RESTART:TOUCHA hiker falls at Smiley's feet.  She says,"Don't mind me.  I'm just lost."#ZAP TOUCH#END:TOUCHA hiker falls at Smiley's feet.  She says,"Thanks for finding me.  Here's 100 bonuspoints.  Have a nice day."#GIVE SCORE 100#DIE#END:SHOT"No violence, please"#END

@HINTS-BOG WOODS#END:TOUCHYou are in Bog Woods.!FIND;Don't know why you are here.!WOODS;Can't get to Bog's cabin. !PATH;Found nothing on path.!HIDDEN;List of hidden objects.!GEM;Missing bonus gem.!HIKER;Missing extra bonus points.#END:FINDRead the scroll. Explore the area.!TOUCH;Return to hints.#END:WOODSFollow path through the woods.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:PATHLook for hidden items in woods.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:HIDDENHidden objects:  -Three people  -22 gems (11 on each side of the road)  -Bonus gem   -Bonus points!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:GEMImmediately southwest of fly generator!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:HIKERCheck out hiker.!TWICE;Still missing points!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:TWICETouch hiker twice.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END

@BARREL#END:TOUCHSmiley finds on over turned barrel of toxic waste.  A sign on it reads, "Anotherfine product from Dr. Z's Living Labs."Swamp flies, a large hairy species ofmosquito, are breeding in the puddles.#END:SHOT#DIE#END
@BONUS#END:TOUCH#PLAY ++ICG#CHAR 04#ZAP TOUCH#END:TOUCHBonus gem worth 10 gems#GIVE GEMS 10#GIVE HEALTH 10#GIVE SCORE 100#DIE
The sign says:"Welcome to Living Labs.Go away!"

@REYE#SHOOT SEEK#RESTART:SHOT#SEND RFANG:DO#SEND LFANG:DO#SEND LEYE:DO#SEND LLLEG3:DO#SEND LLLEG2:DO#SEND LLLEG1:DO#SEND LRLEG3:DO#SEND LRLEG2:DO#SEND LRLEG1:DO#SEND ULLEG3:DO#SEND ULLEG2:DO#SEND ULLEG1:DO#SEND URLEG3:DO#SEND URLEG2:DO#SEND URLEG1:DO#SEND BODY12A:DO#SEND BODY13:DO#SEND BODY1:DO    ' OTHERS BOUND TO 1#SEND BODY10:DO    ' OTHERS BOUND TO 10#DIE#END

@HINTS-LABORATORY GROUNDS#END:TOUCHYou need the green key to get into thebuilding.!GREEN;Can't get to green key.!BUG;Still bugged by bug.!PURPLE;Purple key locked away. #END:GREENDestroy the bug where it is vulnerable.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:BUGShoot the bug's right eye.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:PURPLEFind cyan key inside building.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END

@BOG#END:TOUCHIt is Bog.  He speaks slowly,"Smiley, help me.  You have to stop Dr. Z.He is doing something crazy with LivingLabs.  I tried to stop him, but I'm tooweak to continue.  He is using toxic waste to make a strangemutant building.  The place isbio-mechanical. . . part human, partmechanical.  Kinda weird, too.He plans to create an environment filledwith toxic waste which only he can  tolerate.  Then, he can take over the world.   Get into the labs.  Capture Dr. Z.Only you can save Earth as we know itfrom destruction.By the way, have a nice day."#ZAP TOUCH:TOUCHBog holds up a hand full of pepper.#IF BALLOON THEN FILLSince Smiley has no container, hejust blushes and says, "No thanks, Bog,I just ate."  #END:FILL#SET PEPPERHe pours it into the balloon.  "This is for Bouncer," Bog says.#END :SHOT"No violence, please."#END

@HINTS-BOG'S CABIN#END:TOUCHGo to Bog and get his message.You need the red key to get in the lab.!KEY;Strange item next to key.!STUCK;Stuck in back room.#END:KEYTouch it and find out.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:STUCKFeel around.!ROOM;Still stuck.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:ROOMFind false wall in southwest corner.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END
@score#CYCLE 7#CHAR 07#CHAR 15#RESTART:TOUCH#PLAY +H.CQ3GAB!+WC#GIVE SCORE 100100 points for getting this far!#DIE#END

@HINTS-JAWS#END:TOUCH!TEETH;Bit by teeth.!BLOCK;Yellow congestion blocks way.#END:TEETHThe teeth hurt when you run into them.  Go under and over them tostop movement.!BIT;Still can't get past teeth.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:BITMove when the tooth moves out of the way.Sometimes you have to make two quick moves.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:BLOCKShoot a path. !TOUCH;Return to hints#END

@ACHOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!#IF SNEEZE THEN DO#RESTART:DO#CHAR 62Smiley hears a rumble and then,"Achoo!"The sneeze bomb worked.  Bouncerhas escaped.  And the explosion hasripped the toxic feeding line toDr. Z's hidden lab.#END

@POSTMAN#END:TOUCHSmiley finds a postman groggy from theoutflow of toxic fumes.  He sees a postcard on the floor next to the mail bag.  It's a card Smiley just mailed.It reads:"Yo Rambo,Get a free Smiley Guy momento.  Makea return envelope.  Be sure it isstamped, self-addressed, and lettersize or larger.Send it to:    Smiley Guy    c/o  Al Payne    Route 2  Box 30    Danville, IA 52623                    - Smiley"Smiley hands back the card and returnshis attention to the lab.The postman looks up with admiration and says, "What a guy!"#END

@HINTS-DEEP THROAT#END:TOUCH!MAZE;Where are I?!LOST;Lost.!STILL;Still lost.!SOLU;Solution.#END:MAZEThis is a maze.  The rooms look alike.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:LOSTLeave the key until you find your waythrough.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:STILLEach room has a unique exit out of themaze.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:SOLUAfter going south from the jaws:  to go to the lung, go  south then west    to go to toxic stomach, go  south, south, east!TOUCH;Return to hints#END

@HINTS-DEEP THROAT#END:TOUCH!MAZE;Where are I?!LOST;Lost.!STILL;Still lost.!SOLU;Solution.#END:MAZEThis is a maze.  The rooms look alike.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:LOSTLeave the key until you find your waythrough.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:STILLEach room has a unique exit out of themaze.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:SOLUAfter going south from the jaws:  to go to the lung, go  south then west    to go to toxic stomach, go  south, south, east!TOUCH;Return to hints#END

@HINTS-DEEP THROAT#END:TOUCH!MAZE;Where am I?!LOST;Lost.!STILL;Still lost.!SOLU;Solution.#END:MAZEThis is a maze.  The rooms look alike.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:LOSTLeave the key until you find your waythrough.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:STILLEach room has a unique exit out of themaze.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:SOLUAfter going south from the jaws:  to go to the lung, go  south then west    to go to toxic stomach, go  south, south, east!TOUCH;Return to hints#END
@WORM#CYCLE 2#END:DO#CHAR 247:MOVE ?SEEK#IF CONTACT THEN TOUCH#SEND MOVE:TOUCH#TAKE HEALTH 5 TOOWEAK#SEND DO#END:TOOWEAK#ENDGAME:SHOT#SEND DO#END:GO#DIE#END
@score#CYCLE 7#CHAR 07#CHAR 15#RESTART:TOUCH#PLAY +H.CQ3GAB!+WC#GIVE SCORE 100Hey! 100 points, but watch for worms!#SEND WORM:DO#DIE#END

@HINTS-TOXIC STOMACH#END:TOUCHB-U-R-R-R-P!TRAP;Trapped by toxic worms.!WAY;Maybe there's a smarter way.!WORM;So what about King Worm.!STUMP;Still stumped.#END:TRAPMaybe you'll get lucky.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:WAYCheck out the worm that does not move.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:WORMCut off the food supply.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:STUMPShoot the barrel.!TOUCH;Return to hints
@BARREL#END:TOUCHIt's a barrel of toxic waste thatis feeding all the green worms.It looks full.#END:SHOT#PLAY Q9797#SEND ALL:GO#DIE#END
@BARRELS#END:TOUCHThey are barrels of toxic waste.They are empty.#END:SHOT#PLAY Q9797#DIE#END
@BARRELS#END:TOUCHThey are barrels of toxic waste.They are empty.#END:SHOT#PLAY Q9797#DIE#END
@BARRELS#END:TOUCHThey are barrels of toxic waste.They are empty.#END:SHOT#PLAY Q9797#DIE#END

@KING WORM#END:TOUCHIt looks like an overstuffed toxic worm.It says, "Look fella, I'm King Worm hereand everyone does what I do.  Don't interrupt my feeding, OK?"#END:SHOT#SEND WORM:DO #END:GO#DIE#END
@BUTTON2#END:TOUCH#CHAR 32 #PLAY 6#SEND S1:DOS1 #SEND S2:DOS2#SEND S3:DOS3#SEND S4:DOS4#SEND S5:DOS5#SEND S6:DOS6#CHAR 194#END
@BUTTON4#END:TOUCH#CHAR 32#PLAY 8#SEND W1:DOW1#SEND W2:DOW2#SEND W3:DOW3#SEND W4:DOW4#SEND W5:DOW5#SEND W6:DOW6#CHAR 194#END

@HINTS-HEART#END:TOUCH!CELLS;White cells are attacking.!ARROWS;What do the arrows mean?!SOLUTION;How to get key.#END:CELLSShoot them.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:ARROWSPush buttons and see what happens.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:SOLUTIONPress corresponding button to move arrows in direction they point.Use a sequence which will cleara path.!PATH;One possible solution!TOUCH;Return to hints.#END:PATHSWWSESSWWWWNNNSWhite cells among the arrows can affectoutcome.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END
@WHITECELL#CHAR 233?N?S#CHAR 224?SEEK#CHAR 233?E?W#CHAR 224?SEEK#IF CONTACT THEN TOUCH#RESTART:TOUCHWhite cells!#PLAY 0#TAKE HEALTH 7 WEAK#DIE#END:SHOT#PLAY 0#DIE:WEAK#ENDGAME

@NOZZLE#END:TOUCH#IF AIR THEN SKIP#IF FULL THEN REMOVE#IF BALLOON THEN FIX:SKIPSmiley sees the end of a air pump.It can handle high pressure.#END:FIX#SET ATTACHED#SEND BALLOON:ON#CLEAR BALLOONSmiley attaches the balloon to the endof the air pump.#END:REMOVE#SET AIR#SET BALLOON#CLEAR ATTACHED#CLEAR FULL#SEND BALLOON:SPACESmiley removes the balloon full ofair.#END

@HANDLE#END:TOUCH#IF ATTACHED THEN BLOWSmiley sees an air pump.  He pushesdown on the handle.  Air shoots out.#SEND DOIT#END:BLOW#SET FULLSmiley pushes down on the pump handle.It fills the balloon with air.:DOIT#CHAR 32#SEND AIR1:FLOW1#CHAR 203#end
@BALLOON#end:TOUCHSmiley feels the push of escaping air.#END:SPACE#PLAY 4#CHAR 32#END:ON#PLAY 8#CHAR 168#end:FILLED#PLAY 4#CHAR 79#end

@HINTS-LUNG#END:TOUCH!WHAT;What is the thing?!WHAT;How does it work?!WORK;Why use it?#END:WHATTry touching different parts.!TOUCH;Return to hints.#END:WORKTalk to Bouncer.!TOUCH;Return to hints.
@LABEL#END:TOUCHSmiley finds a label.  It says, "Pump it up, airhead.  Made by A. Schwartz and Egger."#END

@HINTS-LOWER PLUMBING#end:TOUCHThis part of the maze goes nowhere.!ROUTE;One possible route.!SUGG;Another suggestion.#END:ROUTEStay on the outside edges.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:SUGGFollow the common edges with east andwest.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END

@PARTY BALLOON#end:TOUCH#SET BALLOONSmiley finds a limp party balloon.  Hetries to inflate it, but the plastic istoo thick."It needs more pressure," thinks Smiley.He puts it in his pocket.#DIE#END
@HINTS-KNEE (knobby, too)#END:TOUCHUse torches wisely.!DARK;Out of torches.#END:DARKFind straight line out.Run in the dark.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END

@BOUNCER THE BOOGER#CHAR 236?S#CHAR 145?N#PLAY 4#CHAR 236#RESTART:TOUCH#CHAR 145Smiley finds an intelligent lookingpiece of mucus, bouncing like a rubberball.It speaks, "To reach Dr. Z, go throughthe mental void.  But then, what do Iknow?  I'm just a booger."Smiley feels a need to wash his hands.#ZAP TOUCH:TOUCH#char 145"Let's make a deal," Bouncer the booger says.  "I'll give you something you needif you bring me something I want.  Bring  me a sneeze bomb, so I can blow thisjoint." #IF BALLOON THEN COMM1"I see you are not carrying anything Ican use."#SEND GOODBYE#END:COMM1"I see you are carrying a balloon."#IF AIR THEN COMM2:PPR#IF PEPPER THEN COMM3#SEND GOODBYE:COMM2"I see the balloon is full of air."#SEND PPR:COMM3"I see you have pepper in the balloon."#IF AIR THEN EXCHANGE:GOODBYE#LOCK"You need more to make a sneeze bomb.Come back later."?S?E?E?E?E?E?E?E#PLAY 8?W?W?W?W?W?W?W#UNLOCK#RESTART:EXCHANGE#SET SNEEZE"You made a sneeze bomb!"#LOCK#CYCLE 1?S?E?E?E?E?E?E?E#PLAY 8?W?W?W?W?W?W?W?N#SEND BLOCK:DO?N?N?N?N?N?N?N#PLAY 8#PUT E RED KEY"Thanks, Smiley.  Good pickings, fella."?W?W?W?W?W?W?W?W?W#DIE#UNLOCK#END:SHOT"Thanks for the minerals."#RESTART

@HINTS-NECK#END:TOUCH!WHO;What is the green creature?!WHERE;Where is a sneeze bomb?!HOW;How to make a bomb.#END:WHOTake him for what he says.!OK;Is it OK to ge close to him (her/it)??Suppose I want an intelligent conversation or other form of meaningfulinterpersonal relationship?!WHAT;How about it?!TOUCH;Return to hints #END:OKIt's OK as long as you wash your handsafterwords.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:WHATBe cool.  He's not the frog prince.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:WHERELook for ingredients to combine.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:HOW!STEP1;Step 1!STEP2;Step 2!STEP3;Step 3!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:STEP1Get balloon from closed room.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:STEP2Fill balloon with pepper from Bog.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:STEP3Attach balloon to air pump and pushhandle to fill with air.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END

@BLAKEY#CYCLE 3#END:TOUCH"Hi there, big guy." Blakey says."Welcome to Blakey's and Flakey'sDiscount Bargains.  Here's thebest deals you are going to get inthe Living Labs.""By the way," she adds, "it's theonly deal.  Hah!"Blakey points north.  "See Flakeywhen you are done."!ENTER;To enter the store.#END:SHOT"Please, no violence here."#END:ENTER"Come on in."#CYCLE 30/E/W#restart

@FLAKEY#Cycle 3#END:TOUCH"I'm not as nice as my sister Blakey.She lets you in for free.  But you have topay ME to get out.""10 gems to exit," the eight-foot tallFlakey sneers.  "If you don't have it,you are stuck here."!EXIT;Pay 10 gems and exit.#END:SHOT"Nah, hah, you missed."#END:EXIT#TAKE GEMS 10 TOOLOW"Come back anytime."#CYCLE 30/E/W#RESTART:TOOLOW#PLAY 5555"You ain't got 10 gems.  HAR! HAR!"#RESTART
@HEALTH#END:TOUCH#TAKE GEMS 1 TOOPOOR#PLAY I++CG#GIVE HEALTH 1 #RESTART:TOOPOOR#PLAY I--C#CYou do not have any gems.#RESTART
@AMMO#END:TOUCH#TAKE GEMS 1 TOOFEW#PLAY I99#GIVE AMMO 5 #RESTART:TOOFEW#PLAY I--C#CYou do not have any gems.#RESTART

@HINTS-DEEP THROAT#END:TOUCH!MAZE;Where are I?!LOST;Lost.!STILL;Still lost.!SOLU;Solution.#END:MAZEThis is a maze.  The rooms look alike.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:LOSTLeave the key until you find your waythrough.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:STILLEach room has a unique exit out of themaze.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:SOLUAfter going south from the jaws:  to go to the lung, go  south then west    to go to toxic stomach, go  south, south, east!TOUCH;Return to hints#END

It's a note from Bog."Smiley, I've locked Dr. Z in his secretlab, somewhere beyond the brain cells.I've hidden keys to the five locks aroundthe bio-mechanical building.Good luck.            - Bog"

@HINTS-BRAIN CELLS#END:TOUCH!SPARKS;Worried about sparks.!BLOCK;Something blocks your path.!CIRCLES;Going in circles.!PATH;Path to Dr. Z's secret lab.#END:SPARKSWhen dormant, they are unseen and blockyour path . . .only a concern whenactive.Stay south or away from middle of cell.!TOUCH;Return to hints#END:CIRCLESGo forward and backwards.!TOUCH;Return to hints.#END:PATHFrom entrance, take passages blue toblue and red to red.  Turn back into red just exited to arrive at another red.Go through the only adjacent passage toarrive at an eastern most passage.Go east to lab.!TOUCH;Return to hints.#END:BLOCKDormant sparks.  Only harmful whenactive.  Go around them.!TOUCH;Return to hints.#END
@DR. Z'S SECRET LABThere's Dr. Z inside the giant bio-mechanical head.#PLAY --QCF#HFIEE!DD!QCIX5555#end

@HINTS-SECRET LAB#END:TOUCH!ZAPPED;Zapped by shots from barrier.!VOID;Way to mental void.#end:ZAPPEDFind the mental void.!TOUCH;Return to hints#end:VOIDGo west to white passageway.!TOUCH;Return to hints.

@points#CYCLE 7#CHAR 07#CHAR 15#RESTART:TOUCH#PLAY +H.CQ3GAB!+WC#GIVE SCORE 100#SEND DRZ:DODr. Z sneers.  "So, you have justreceived 100 points for getting thisfar," he says.  "Well, you still haveto catch me.  See you around, Smiley!"#DIE#END

@DRZ#CYCLE 1#WALK OPP SEEK #RESTART:TOUCH#SEND BARREL:DIE#PLAY --QCF#HFIEE!DD!QCYou have caught Dr. Z and put an end tohis evil plans!Bog, who now looks well rested, appearsfrom the exit of the ear.  He takesDr. Z and drags the menace from the lab.Smiley beams with pride.#DIE#END:THUD#LOCK#CLEAR THUD#IF STUCK2 THEN MOVE2#IF STUCK1 THEN MOVE1#SET STUCK1?E?E?W?N?N?N?S#UNLOCK#RESTART  :MOVE1#CHAR 32"NAH, NAH, can't catch me," cries Z.#PLAY 5555#WALK SEEK?W?W?W?S?S?S?E?N#WALK OPP SEEK#CHAR 02#SET STUCK2#CLEAR STUCK1#UNLOCK#RESTART:MOVE2?E?E?E?E?N?N#CLEAR STUCK2#UNLOCK#RESTART#end:SHOT"You missed."#RESTART
